sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 39

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 39:1
items.html: The place of the Temple is Beriah, and the Land of Israel is Yetzirah, and outside the Land is Assiyah. And the place of ruins corresponds to the Klipot. (Item 44).
